errors.text_span: В диаграмата са включени четири категории, всяка обозначена с различен цвят: син за „Под 1 година“ (13,6%), оранжев за „От 1 до 5 години“ (18,2%), златист за „От 6 до 15 години“ (36,4%) и тъмнозелен за „От 16 до 30 години“ (31,8%)
errors.evidence: The description completely scrambles the mapping between categories, colors, and values. For example, 13.6% corresponds to 'Над 1 до 5 години' (red slice), not 'Под 1 година' (blue, which is not in the chart). 18.2% corresponds to 'От 16 до 30 години' (green slice), not 'От 1 до 5 години' (orange). 31.8% corresponds to 'Над 31 години' (purple slice), not 'От 16 до 30 години' (dark green).

The description fails to mention the existence of a fifth category, 'Под 1 година', which is present in the legend but has a value of 0% and thus no corresponding slice in the chart. The description states there are only four categories.
The chart clearly has a legend on the right side, which lists five categories and their associated colors.

errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Each of the four pie slices has a percentage value labeled directly inside it.

errors.text_span: но процентите за всеки сектор са изписани извън самата диаграма
errors.evidence: This is false. The percentage values are written inside the pie slices.

errors.evidence: The segments are not sorted by size. In clockwise order from the top, their values are 31.8%, 18.2%, 36.4%, and 13.6%, which is not a descending sequence.
